LESSON: FUNCTIONS OF THE BIBLE

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The Bible
Topic 3.1: Functions of the Bible

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Functions of the Bible. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: Why is the Bible important in the life of a Christian?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. explain the importance of the Bible in the society today
2. describe how the Bible promotes holistic growth
3. appreciate the Bible as the inspired Word of God

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: FUNCTIONS OF THE BIBLE
This lesson teaches Functions of the Bible for Grade 7 CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

STUDY STEPS
1. explain the importance of the Bible in the society today
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. describe how the Bible promotes holistic growth
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
3. appreciate the Bible as the inspired Word of God
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Functions of the Bible using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Functions of the Bible above.
2. Explain Functions of the Bible to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Functions of the Bible.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Functions of the Bible with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Functions of the Bible important for a Grade 7 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why is the Bible important in the life of a Christian?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. explain the importance of the Bible in the society today
2. describe how the Bible promotes holistic growth
3. appreciate the Bible as the inspired Word of God

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
